title: Aspire K3 Vape Tank
description: The Aspire K3 Vape Tank is the perfect choice for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vapers seeking simplicity, durability, and exceptional flavour. Designed for convenience and reliability, the K3 Tank features Aspire’s renowned Nautilus BVC coils, known for their long-lasting performance and ability to deliver rich, full-bodied flavour from high-PG. 50/50 and nic salt e-liquids. With a 2ml e-liquid capacity, the K3’s compact Pyrex glass tank resists wear and corrosion, making it ideal for everyday vaping. The replaceable 510 drip tip allows for customisation, while the tank’s pre-set airflow ensures a consistent and satisfying MTL draw without the need for adjustments. The Aspire K3 Tank is compatible with most 510-threaded batteries, offering a seamless connection and effortless usability. Its bottom-fill design simplifies refilling, ensuring clean and efficient operation, even for beginners. Whether you’re looking for a reliable backup tank or an easy-to-use option for everyday use, the Aspire K3 combines practicality with performance in a sleek, compact package.
